name: projectpilot
description: ProjectPilot turns rough product ideas into clean software plans, implementation prompts, and QA checklists for AI-assisted coding.

interface.shortDescription: Turn rough AI coding ideas into clean, shippable software.
interface.longDescription: ProjectPilot is an assistant workflow pack for Codex and Claude Code. It helps AI-assisted builders clarify ideas, design clean architecture, implement readable code, improve UX quality, verify before shipping, and generate high-signal Claude Code prompts.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use ProjectPilot to turn my rough idea into a clean build blueprint before coding.
